Property Transactions

English Reports

REPORT-1

1.1. Highest Transaction in a Neighbourhood

On August 08, 2024, AN NARJIS recorded the highest investment activity, marked by a significant transaction valued at SAR 1,265,056,835 for a 2,755 sqm property at a premium rate of SAR 8,500 per sqm—indicating strong investor confidence. HITTEEN and AN NADHEEM followed closely in terms of high-value investment zones.

1.2. Most Active Areas by Transactions by Neighbourhood

AN NADHEEM emerged as the most active neighborhood, recording over 2,461 transactions, which underscores its high liquidity and sustained investor interest.

1.3. Most Active Areas by Transactions by Zoning

Residential plots lead in transaction volume with 4,185 deals, highlighting strong interest in land development and resale, while Residential Building, though lower in count (2,773 transactions), dominate in value—exceeding SAR 4,462,666,366, reflecting demand for larger or multi-unit assets.

1.4. Neighbourhoods with the Highest Property Rates (SAR/sqm)

Al Nakhil ranks highest nationally with an average property rate of SAR 22,598.9/sqm, based on 2 transactions in the Residential Building zone. AR RAHMANIYAH and AL YASMEEN follow closely, averaging SAR 16,000 and SAR 13,294.88/sqm, respectively, from 1 and 52 transactions.

1.5. High Demand, Low Supply Neighbourhoods

Al Nakhil leads as a high-demand, low-supply neighbourhood, registering an impressive SAR 22,598.9/sqm in 2 transaction. Following closely are AR RAHMANIYAH and AR RAED, which posted SAR 16,000/sqm (1 transactions) and SAR 10,821.75/sqm (2 transactions), respectively.

1.6. Development Density Ratio (DDR) by Zone

Residential commercial zones recorded the highest average Development Density Ratio (DDR), with built-up areas occupying 81% of available land. Residential plots followed with 65%, while Residential Building showed a 47% utilization. Single family villa zones had the lowest at just 32%.

1.7. Price Band Analysis – Affordability Segmentation

An affordability-based analysis reveals that the largest share of transactions—over 28%—falls within the Under SAR 400,000 segment, accounting for 2,782 properties. Properties priced in the SAR 400,000-600,000 range represent 21% of transactions (2,136 units), while those in the SAR 600,000-1,100,000 range form 26% of the market (2,557 deals). Transactions in the Greater SAR 1,100,000 segment contribute 25% to the overall volume, totaling 2,525 units.

Arabic Reports

REPORT-1

1.1. أعلى معاملة في حي

في August 08, 2024، سجل حي AN NARJIS أعلى نشاط استثماري، بصفقة عقارية كبيرة بلغت قيمتها SAR 1,265,056,835 لعقار بمساحة 2,755 متر مربع، وبسعر مميز قدره SAR 8,500 ريال/م²—مما يعكس ثقة المستثمرين. تلتها مناطق HITTEEN and AN NADHEEM من حيث قيمة الاستثمار.

1.2. المناطق الأكثر نشاطًا حسب المعاملات والحي

برز حي AN NADHEEM كأكثر الأحياء نشاطًا، مسجلًا أكثر من 2,461 معاملة، مما يدل على سيولة عالية واهتمام مستمر من المستثمرين.

1.3. المناطق الأكثر نشاطًا حسب المعاملات والتقسيم

تصدرت منطقة Residential plots من حيث عدد المعاملات بـ 4,185 صفقة، مما يعكس اهتمامًا قويًا بتطوير الأراضي وإعادة البيع. في المقابل، تفوقت Residential Building من حيث القيمة الإجمالية رغم عدد معاملات أقل (2,773)، بإجمالي تجاوز SAR 4,462,666,366 ريال.

1.4. الأحياء ذات أعلى معدلات الأسعار (ريال/م²)

تصدرت Al Nakhil القائمة بمعدل سعر SAR 22,598.9 ريال/م²، بناءً على 2 معاملة في منطقة المباني السكنية. تلتها AR RAHMANIYAH و AL YASMEEN بمعدل SAR 16,000 و SAR 13,294.88 ريال/م²، من خلال 1 و 52 معاملة على التوالي.

1.5. أحياء ذات طلب مرتفع وعرض منخفض

احتل حي Al Nakhil الصدارة من حيث الطلب المرتفع والعرض المنخفض، بسعر SAR 22,598.9 ريال/م² في 2 معاملة. تلاه كل من AR RAHMANIYAH و AR RAED بمعدلات SAR 16,000 و SAR 10,821.75 ريال/م² لكل منهما، بناءً على 1 و 2 معاملة على التوالي.

1.6. نسبة كثافة التطوير (DDR) حسب المنطقة

سجلت مناطق Residential commercial أعلى متوسط لنسبة كثافة التطوير، حيث بلغت المساحة المبنية 81% من الأراضي المتاحة. تلتها Residential plots بنسبة 65%، ثم Residential Building بنسبة 47%، بينما كانت Single family villa الأدنى بنسبة 32%.

1.7. تحليل شرائح الأسعار – توزيع القدرة على الشراء

تشير التحليلات إلى أن أكبر نسبة من المعاملات—أكثر من 28%—تقع ضمن فئة أقل من 500,000 ريال، وتمثل 2,782 عقارًا. أما الفئة بين 500 ألف إلى مليون ريال فتمثل 21% (2,136 وحدة)، وتليها فئة المليون إلى مليونين بنسبة 26% (2,557 صفقة). فيما تشكل المعاملات التي تتجاوز مليوني ريال نسبة 25% من الإجمالي، بعدد 2,525 وحدة.

Unit Transactions

Reports

REPORT-1

1. High-Value Transactions

On May 01, 2025, a 285 sqm sqm unit in An Narjis fetched SAR 3,130,000, equating to 11,001 per sqm, marking the top sale. Irqah saw a 292 sqm sqm property sold for SAR 2,766,000 ( 9,484per sqm) on March 02, 2025, reflecting strong interest in luxury real estate.

2. Premium Pricing by Neighborhood

Ar Rabwah leads with an average price of SAR 17,500 per sqm, followed by Al Margab at SAR 14,900 per sqm and As Sulaimanyah at SAR 12,500 per sqm. As Salhiyah offers more affordable options, averaging around SAR 200 per sqm

3. High-Demand Neighborhoods

An Narjis recorded approximately 260 transactions, showcasing significant buyer enthusiasm. Twaeeq and Jareer followed with about 50 and 30 sales, respectively, indicating robust market activity.

4. Property Type Trends

Residential buildings in An Narjis, priced between SAR 74 to SAR 11,271 per sqm, attract upscale buyers. Al Aziziyah villas, ranging from SAR 301 to SAR 7,677 per sqm, appeal to family buyers. Residential commercial properties in An Narjis, averaging SAR 7,721 per sqm, draw investor interest.

5. Pricing Segmentation

Luxury buyers focus on Al Margab and Ar Rabwah, where prices reach up to SAR 53,400 per sqm. As Salhiyah and Al Haier cater to more budget-conscious buyers, with prices spanning SAR 200 to SAR 400 per sqm.

6. Largest Plot Deals

On April 18, 2025, a 319 sqm plot in Al Mahdiyah sold for SAR 2,300,000 (SAR 7,207 per sqm). Ash Shifa recorded a 308 sqm plot sale for SAR 900,000 on January 12, 2025, highlighting demand for sizable development land.

7. Top Land Transactions by Value in Zone

The Residential Building zone led land transaction activity with a cumulative value of SAR 497,347,610, and an average rate of SAR 6,707 per sqm, highlighting its appeal for high-value acquisitions. Close behind, the Single Family Villa zone recorded SAR 64,711,061 in total land sales, reflecting ongoing investor interest in strategic plot locations.

4. Property Type Trends

Residential buildings in An Narjis appeal to premium buyers with prices ranging from SAR 74 to SAR 11,271 per sqm. Villas in Al Aziziyah attract families, priced between SAR 301 and SAR 7,677 per sqm. Commercial properties in An Narjis draw investor interest, averaging around SAR 7,721 per sqm.

5. Pricing Segmentation

The market serves diverse buyers, with luxury buyers concentrated in Al Margab and Ar Rabwah, where prices can reach up to SAR 53,400 per sqm. Meanwhile, neighborhoods like As Salhiyah and Al Haier offer more affordable options, ranging from SAR 200 to SAR 400 per sqm.

6. Largest Plot Deals

Demand for large plots remains strong; Al Mahdiyah saw a top sale of SAR 2,300,000 for a 319 sqm plot (SAR 7,207 per sqm) on April 18, 2025. Ash Shifa recorded SAR 900,000 for a 308 sqm plot on January 12, 2025, highlighting interest in sizable project-ready land.

7. Top Land Transactions by Value in Zone

Posting the highest land transaction value, the Residential Building zone reached SAR 497.35 million with an average rate of SAR 6,707 per sqm, reinforcing its role in driving high-capital acquisitions. Single Family Villa zones, with SAR 64.71 million in total, also attracted meaningful investment.

A 319 sqm plot in Al Mahdiyah sold for SAR 2,300,000 (SAR SAR 7,207 per sqm) on April 18, 2025. On January 12, 2025, a 308 sqm plot in Ash Shifa fetched SAR 900,000, highlighting demand for large development parcels.

7. Top Land Transactions by Value in Zone

The real estate data reveals strong momentum in the Residential Building zone, which amassed SAR 497.35 million in land sales at a unit rate of SAR 6,707 per sqm. The Single Family Villa zone, with a transaction volume of SAR 64.71 million, maintained a solid presence in investor portfolios focused on individual residences.
